title: [CLO Beginner's Guide] CLO Ecosystem
description: The brand-new CLO beginner course series is now online! Let's take a look at the detailed introduction of the CLO Ecosystem and understand the CLO product ecosystem. The main components are CLO, CLO-SET, and CONNECT.
transcript:
Hello everyone, before this course begins, let me introduce you to the CLO Ecosystem.  
The CLO Ecosystem is the ecosystem of CLO.  
CLO Virtual Fashion Company is creating a new ecosystem for digital fashion.  
Through the integration of clothing design software such as CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Genie, as well as Closet and Connect, we focus on the content of the clothing platform,  
deeply involved in clothing from design development to production and promotion throughout the entire process,  
to build an efficient and sustainable workflow.  

In this video, I will explain the basic concepts of CLO, Closet, and Connect,  
describe their basic workflow, and show their applications in the process.  

First, I will explain what CLO is and what its main functions are.  
CLO is software based on 3D clothing sewing technology.  
It provides an efficient virtual clothing solution by digitizing clothing design, production, marketing, and so on.  
By using CLO, users can maximize their creativity,  
improve productivity,  
and increase their efficiency.  
This plays an important role in the digital transformation of the clothing industry.  

Next, I will introduce the main functions of CLO.  
One of the main functions of CLO is the ability to create clothes in real time,  
quickly and accurately achieving the designed structure and clothing effect,  
reacting in real time to fabric changes,  
and adjusting the effect after the clothing pattern is made.  
In addition, during the design stage,  
CLO can effectively adjust the clothing color and style design,  
and create 3D clothing samples to replace physical samples,  
thus saving production time and cost.  
Finally, the 3D clothing created in CLO can be applied in various fields,  
such as e-commerce content,  
providing more possibilities for digital clothing creation applications.  

Next is Closet.  
Closet is a cloud-based platform.  
You can upload and manage your 3D assets here,  
and share and communicate with internal and external teams.  
One of Closet’s main functions is the use of a multi-layer file structure.  
This structure enables more efficient file management.  
You can set the corresponding layer structure according to the needs of different organizations,  
such as companies, brands, product lines, developers, and studios,  
and manage and share your 3D resources across different layers.  

In addition, you can also store digital assets in Closet,  
uploading various file formats,  
not only the 3D file formats shown in the picture,  
but also documents such as DXF, Adobe Illustrator, Excel, and PDF.  
Closet is also a platform that facilitates communication.  
During processes like style design, color modification, and other suggestions,  
you can share your ideas with internal or external teams on the platform,  
communicate with each other, and obtain more accurate and timely feedback.  

Finally, by using various tools such as online process lists and material lists,  
you can systematically manage the entire production process of the product,  
achieving an efficient workflow.  

The following is a description of the concept of Closet.  
Closet is a face-to-face global user,  
digital fashion community, and online mall.  
Creators can communicate with each other on the platform,  
users can upload their works here,  
display and sell them,  
and face-to-face suppliers will also upload their digitized products here.  

First of all, in the shop category,  
you can easily obtain all the materials needed for digital clothing creation,  
and you can also use the 3D resources created by Closet to generate profits.  
The work wall is a display space.  
Creators can share inspiration here using the space for works created by Closet.  
This promotes active communication between users  
and creates an environment full of creativity.  

Competitions are regularly held by fashion brands and Closet.  
The competition space exists solely to provide creators with opportunities to showcase themselves  
and participate in the innovation of the digital fashion industry.  
Designers can gain industry recognition through these competitions,  
expand their career paths,  
and contribute to the development of digital fashion.  

In the application section, various functions are included.  
First is Everywhere.  
It is a toolset  
that can automatically optimize clothing for games, entertainment, virtual spaces, and other digital environments.  

Next is LiveSync.  
It can quickly and conveniently connect Closet and Unreal Engine,  
allowing users to directly import clothing and materials created in Closet into Unreal Engine.  
This lets them use various Unreal resources,  
including MetaHuman.  

Next is AR.  
This function allows users to convert the clothing they create  
into an AR filter,  
achieving more diversified uses.  

Next is Genie.  
This is free software.  
Even without professional clothing design knowledge,  
users can easily engage in digital clothing design.  
Genie provides a convenient tool for non-clothing professionals,  
allowing users to quickly,  
easily,  
and enjoyably express their creativity.  

Finally, there is Gamewear.  
Gamewear is designed for creators and players,  
allowing digital fashion designers to upload and share  
customized clothing optimized for various games.  
Whether you are the creator of the latest design  
or a player pursuing a unique character style needed for a game,  
you can find it in Gamewear.  
It perfectly combines creativity and fashion.  

The above has introduced the overall concept and main functions of Closet and Connect.  
Now let's go through Closet's basic workflow video  
to learn more about how to use these tools in the actual clothing production process.  

First is the inspiration creation stage.  
You can use Closet’s visualized design version to create an inspiration version.  
Then, in the Connect process,  
you obtain resources that align with the design inspiration,  
as reference materials,  
such as fabric,  
textures,  
and other design assets that fit the design inspiration.  

Next, you can plan your design in Closet.  
If you have a favorite or popular online clothing style,  
you can import it into Closet,  
organize the product list of all styles,  
making it easy to check,  
and then enter the design creation stage.  

At this stage,  
you can use the online style to modify the color scheme.  
You can also redesign from the basic version.  
The final design effect can be uploaded to Closet,  
shared, and communicated with your partners.  

In Closet,  
you can use the current 3D clothing preview effect  
to give feedback on clothing modifications,  
or you can receive modification suggestions from your partners,  
and review the design feedback.  

After receiving the feedback,  
you can upload it to Closet,  
and make modifications within Closet.  
Once the modifications are complete,  
you can upload it to Closet again,  
conduct a second review,  
and then finalize the design plan.  

After the final plan is confirmed,  
you can integrate the entire series of styles,  
select them in Closet,  
decide whether to use them or not,  
further improve the clothing styles used,  
and then check the final product line style.  

When you enter the listing stage,  
you can add additional information to Closet  
for the clothing styles that will eventually enter production.  
For example, you can add size information,  
codes, etc.,  
and mark information such as paper samples.  
You can also organize the clothing  
and the material list for production costs.  
You can ensure that all preparation work needed in the production process  
is successfully completed.  
You can share the file again on Closet,  
and check the supply list online.  

There are also many ways to promote finished clothing in the market.  
You can upload it to Connect,  
share it with others,  
communicate, or sell it.  

In addition, you can use the various services  
we just mentioned,  
such as wearable equipment  
and enhanced real-time technology,  
to bring your designs into the virtual universe.  

You can use 3D clothing in various industries,  
such as games,  
the metaverse,  
and more.  

In addition, you can use Closet,  
which is the most advanced technology on the market.  
Closet and Connect participate in every stage like this.  
From concept construction to final sales and expansion,  
they make the whole process seamless.

chunks.title: [CLO Beginner's Guide] CLO Ecosystem
chunks.content: # CLO Beginner's Guide: CLO Ecosystem This document explains the CLO Ecosystem, including CLO software, Closet, and Connect platforms, their workflows, functions, and applications for virtual fashion design and production. --- ## Overview of the CLO Ecosystem The CLO Ecosystem, developed by CLO Virtual Fashion Company, is a comprehensive digital fashion environment integrating clothing design software (CLO, Marvelous Designer, Genie) with cloud platforms (Closet and Connect). It supports the entire fashion process from design and development to production and promotion, enabling an efficient and sustainable workflow. --- ## CLO Software: 3D Clothing Design and Virtual Production This section describes CLO, a 3D clothing sewing software central to digital fashion transformation. - **Core Technology**: CLO uses 3D clothing sewing technology to digitize clothing design, production, and marketing. - **Key Benefits**: - Enables real-time creation and visualization of garments. - Accurately simulates fabric behavior and garment structure. - Supports dynamic adjustments for fabric changes and pattern modifications. - Allows efficient color and style design during the early stages. - Produces 3D clothing samples as alternatives to physical samples, reducing time and costs. - **Applications**: CLO's 3D garments can be used in e-commerce, digital fashion content, games, and virtual environments, expanding digital clothing creation possibilities. --- ## Closet: Cloud-Based 3D Asset Management and Collaboration Platform Closet is a cloud platform designed for managing 3D assets and facilitating communication across teams. - **File Management**: - Uses a multi-layer file structure for organized management by companies, brands, product lines, developers, and studios. - Supports diverse file formats including 3D files, DXF, Adobe Illustrator, Excel, and PDF. - **Collaboration**: - Enables sharing of designs, feedback, and modification suggestions among internal and external teams. - Facilitates timely, accurate communication during style design and color modification. - **Workflow Management**: - Provides online process lists and material lists to systematically manage production workflows. - **Digital Fashion Community and Marketplace**: - Functions as a global user community and online mall. - Creators can upload, display, and sell digital fashion works. - Suppliers upload digitized products for creators. - **Shop Category**: - Offers materials needed for digital clothing creation. - Allows monetization of 3D resources created in Closet. - **Work Wall**: - A space for creators to share inspirations and works, fostering creative communication. - **Competitions**: - Regularly held by fashion brands and Closet to showcase talent and promote innovation. - Designers gain industry recognition and career opportunities. --- ## Connect and Additional CLO Ecosystem Tools Connect and other tools expand the CLO Ecosystem’s digital fashion capabilities. - **Everywhere**: - A toolset that optimizes clothing automatically for games, entertainment, and virtual spaces. - **LiveSync**: - Integrates Closet with Unreal Engine for direct import of clothing and materials. - Enables use of Unreal Engine resources, including MetaHuman. - **AR (Augmented Reality)**: - Converts created clothing into AR filters for diversified usage. - **Genie**: - Free software allowing users without professional clothing design knowledge to easily create digital clothing.

chunks.title: [CLO Beginner's Guide] CLO Ecosystem
chunks.content: --- ## Connect and Additional CLO Ecosystem Tools Connect and other tools expand the CLO Ecosystem’s digital fashion capabilities. - **Everywhere**: - A toolset that optimizes clothing automatically for games, entertainment, and virtual spaces. - **LiveSync**: - Integrates Closet with Unreal Engine for direct import of clothing and materials. - Enables use of Unreal Engine resources, including MetaHuman. - **AR (Augmented Reality)**: - Converts created clothing into AR filters for diversified usage. - **Genie**: - Free software allowing users without professional clothing design knowledge to easily create digital clothing. - **Gamewear**: - Platform for creators and players to upload and share customized game-optimized clothing. - Supports unique character styling and combines creativity with fashion. --- ## Closet Workflow: From Inspiration to Production and Promotion This section outlines the step-by-step workflow using Closet and Connect for clothing production. ### 1. Inspiration Creation - Use Closet’s visualized design version to create an inspiration mood board. - Obtain relevant resources (fabric, textures, design assets) via Connect to support the inspiration. ### 2. Design Planning - Import favorite or trending online clothing styles into Closet. - Organize product lists and styles for easy reference. ### 3. Design Creation - Modify color schemes or redesign from a basic version within Closet. - Upload and share design effects for partner review and collaboration. ### 4. Feedback and Iteration - Use Closet’s 3D clothing previews to review and provide feedback. - Receive modification suggestions from partners. - Upload revised designs and conduct multiple review cycles until finalization. ### 5. Finalizing Designs and Product Lines - Integrate all styles into a series. - Select and improve styles as needed. - Confirm the final product line. ### 6. Listing and Production Preparation - Add detailed information such as size, codes, and paper sample flags in Closet. - Organize clothing and material lists to calculate production costs. - Share files and check supply lists online to ensure readiness. ### 7. Promotion and Sales - Upload finished clothing to Connect to share, communicate, or sell. - Utilize wearable equipment and real-time enhanced technology to bring designs into virtual universes. - Apply 3D clothing across industries such as gaming and the metaverse. --- ## CLO Ecosystem Summary Closet and Connect support every step from concept creation to final sales and expansion, creating a seamless process for digital fashion workflows. The ecosystem integrates advanced technology and community platforms to empower creators, designers, and brands in the evolving digital fashion industry.
